questions.passage: When I was in Charlottesville, I would go to a local coffee shop every day and never went to Starbucks. But when I was traveling, I would realize that all of a sudden I loved going to Starbucks. When I was in the psychology building (Gilmer Hall) in Charlottesville and saw a graduate student walking by, I would greet them with a very curt “hey.” When I saw the same graduate student at a conference in Las Vegas, I went “Hey, Gary, so nice to see you!” and almost hugged him.
questions.prompt: How did the author’s responses change when he travelled?

He welcomed familiar stores and people more warmly away from home.
He greeted the student more curtly in Las Vegas.
He visited Starbucks every day in Charlottesville.

optionsZh: 在家出门都避开 Starbucks。
出门时更热情地欢迎熟悉店铺和熟人。
在 Las Vegas 更冷淡招呼学生。
在 Charlottesville 天天去 Starbucks。
analyses: A traveling 时突然喜欢去，与此相反。
B 咖啡店偏好和对同一学生的招呼都随地点变化。
C curt hey 是校内，旅行见面更热情。
D 在当地去 local coffee shop，never went to Starbucks。这里是个人轶事，不是群体实验结果。

evidence.quote: when I was traveling, I would realize that all of a sudden I loved going to Starbucks.
Hey, Gary, so nice to see you!

vocabulary.context: 描述校园内随意冷淡的 hey，与外地热情招呼形成对比

questions.passage: It turned out that those in the mobility condition used more anxiety-related words while describing their future mobile lives than those in the stability or the control conditions, and that the more anxiety-related words participants used, the stronger familiarity-liking effect they showed. In other words, stress and anxiety amplify our tendency to like a familiar object.
questions.prompt: How is the stress-and-anxiety sentence connected to the preceding result?
questions.promptZh: 压力焦虑句与前面结果如何相连？
options: It proves a clinical diagnosis for every participant.
It reverses the reported relation so more anxiety words mean weaker familiarity preference.
It reports that stress was independently eliminated in all conditions.
It restates the author's interpretation of stronger familiarity preference alongside more anxiety-related language.
optionsZh: 证明每个参与者临床诊断。
反转为焦虑词越多、熟悉偏好越弱。
报告所有条件压力均被独立消除。
重述作者对更多焦虑语言伴随更强熟悉偏好的解释。
analyses: A anxiety-related words 不等于诊断焦虑障碍。
B stronger 方向不能反写。
C 没有压力消除治疗或操纵的说明。
D In other words 接作者机制性解释；焦虑词与效应强度关联不单独证明压力是排除一切他因的唯一原因。

To claim familiarity always produces optimal decisions.
To critically examine what familiarity implies for exploring potential partners.

analyses: A 开头明确 replicable。
B 当前是联系决策模型的讨论，非新试验。

questions.promptZh: 称效应 replicable 与下一句怎样配合？
options: The author acknowledges repeated findings but then asks readers to consider their implications critically.
Replicable means its implications must never be questioned.
It declares every prior experiment false.
It guarantees the effect alone produces the best choice in every real situation.
